verdict.rationale: cubic's agent can generate fixes for review findings and commit them straight to the PR branch ('Fix with cubic'; 'By default, cubic pushes commits directly to your PR branch'). It also opens and maintains a rolling pull request for wiki exports. This is limited to review-fix and wiki flows, not a general agent workflow for staging changes, writing commits, branching and opening PRs; the PR-description feature only writes descriptions for PRs that already exist. Missing for 10: agent-driven staging of changes, documented commit-message authoring, agent branch creation, agent opening of PRs for arbitrary work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
